title: Addressing Inquiries about History: An Efficient and Practical Framework for Evaluating Open-domain Chatbot Consistency
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of chatbot consistency, i.e., avoiding contradictory statements about facts or opinions within a conversation. It does not evaluate the ethical, moral, or religious content of the chatbot's responses. The framework is designed to be content-agnostic in terms of values, focusing solely on logical consistency.
